title: Understanding Tool-Mediated Interaction Failures in Agentic GUI Software: An Empirical Study
abstract: arXiv:2610.31698v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly complete tasks through live graphical user interfaces (GUIs). Because the model cannot directly operate the GUI, these systems often rely on tools to capture screenshots or UI trees, translate model outputs into GUI actions, and report whether the interface changed. We study failures where this tool-mediated interaction makes the agent's view of the task diverge from the live GUI. We construct Malva, a defect library with 335 confirmed real-world failures from 40 open-source applications. These failures fall into 11 defect patterns rooted in state representation, state transition, and synchronization problems. They are widespread: 90% of the studied applications contain more than one defect type. translated_title: 理解智能体GUI软件中工具介导的交互失败：一项实证研究
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）智能体越来越多地通过实时图形用户界面（GUI）来完成任务。由于模型无法直接操作GUI，这些系统通常依赖工具来捕获屏幕截图或UI树、将模型输出转换为GUI动作，并报告界面是否发生了变化。我们研究了这种工具介导的交互导致智能体对任务的认知与实时GUI产生偏差的失败情况。我们构建了Malva，一个包含来自40个开源应用的335个已确认真实失败案例的缺陷库。这些失败可归纳为11种缺陷模式，其根源在于状态表示、状态转换和同步问题。这些失败广泛存在：90%的被研究应用包含不止一种缺陷类型。它们还常常是静默的：86.6%的失败中出现不正确性，其中包括119个在没有故障终止信号的情况下产生错误行为的案例。我们通过MalvaGuard将这一分类体系进行落地实现。
tldr: 该研究构建了包含335个真实失败案例的Malva缺陷库，首次系统性地揭示了LLM智能体在通过工具介导与GUI交互时的11种失败模式，并提出MalvaGuard来检测这类广泛存在且往往静默发生的交互缺陷。
en_tdlr: This study constructs Malva, a defect library of 335 confirmed real-world failures, to systematically characterize 11 defect patterns in tool-mediated GUI interaction failures of LLM agents, and introduces MalvaGuard to detect these widespread and often silent failures.
